name: Find Mecatol Rex
text: Have found Mecatol Rex and every system adjacent to it.

name: Survey the Rocks
text: Have found 1 in 8 of the asteroid fields on the map, rounded up, and at least 2 (all of them if there are fewer than 2).

name: Wormhole Cartographer
text: Have found systems with half of the wormhole types on the map, rounded up, and at least 2 (all of them if there are fewer than 2).

name: Catalogue the Anomalies
text: Have found 1 system of each anomaly type on the map.

name: Find the Thrones
text: Have found the home systems of 3 other players.

name: Edge of the Map
text: Have found 4 systems on the edge of the map.

name: Chart the Expanse
text: Round 3 or later: have found 1/3 of the systems on the map, rounded up.

name: Master Cartographer
text: Round 3 or later: have found at least half of the systems on the map, and more systems than each other player.

name: Know More Than They Do
text: Round 3 or later: have found the home systems of 2 players who have not found yours.

name: Run Silent
text: Round 3 or later: have 3 or more flagships, war suns, dreadnoughts or carriers on the game board that no other player has in view.

name: Ghost Fleet
text: Round 3 or later: have 5 or more non-fighter ships outside your home system that no other player has in view.

name: Hidden Shipyard
text: Round 3 or later: have a space dock outside your home system that no other player has in view.

name: Dark Colony
text: Round 3 or later: control 3 planets outside your home system, in systems no other player has in view.

name: Shroud the Throne
text: Round 3 or later: no other player has your home system in view.

name: Secret Passage
text: Round 3 or later: have ships in 2 systems that share a wormhole type, with neither system in any other player's view.

name: Lurk in the Nebula
text: Round 3 or later: have 3 or more non-fighter ships in a single nebula that no other player has in view.

name: Eyes on the Throne
text: Have the home systems of 2 other players in your view.

name: Watch the Leader
text: Have in view the home system of another player who has the most victory points, with at least 3. A tie for the most counts.

name: Shadow Every Rival
text: Have units of 4 different other players in your view.

name: Mark the Flagships
text: Have the flagships of 2 other players in your view.

name: Cast a Wide Net
text: Have ships in 5 systems, none of which are adjacent to each other.

name: Strike From the Fog
text: During your tactical action, win a space combat against a player who, at the start of that action, had none of the systems your ships moved from in view.

name: Appear From Nowhere
text: During your tactical action, move ships into a system adjacent to another player's home system, from systems that player did not have in view at the start of that action.

name: Into the Unknown
text: During your tactical action, win a combat or gain control of a planet in the active system, if you had not found that system at the start of that action.

name: Blind Them
text: Win a space combat that destroys another player's last ships in that system, leaving the system out of their view.

name: Silent Landing
text: During your tactical action, gain control of a planet in a system that no other player has in view at the end of your turn.

name: Long Range Recon
text: During a single tactical action, find 3 systems you had not found before.

name: Witness the Fall
text: Have in your view a space combat you are not part of, in which a player loses their last ships in that system.

name: Join the Consensus
text: Vote, along with at least 2 other players, for an outcome that is elected with no votes cast for any other outcome.

name: Kingmaker
text: Vote for an outcome that is elected without a tie, when without your votes another outcome would have had more votes.

name: Read the Room
text: In a single agenda phase, vote for the elected outcome of both agendas, when each agenda also received votes for another outcome.

name: Cast the Deciding Word
text: As the speaker, break a tie to decide an agenda's outcome.
